findings.label: drug_lipid reads pct_mean, not pct_assay
findings.detail: Checkpoint #7 literally specifies reading pct_assay; the code reads lipid_samples.pct_mean[(rowno-1)*4+idx]. Result is identical because pct_mean = mean([pct_assay]) and each compound row has a single injection, so pct_mean == pct_assay (both unrounded) and the gold ratio 0.841429 is reproduced. Consumed column name differs from checkpoint wording only.

findings.label: Extra % Mean column beyond plan/checkpoint column list
findings.detail: Checkpoint #2 names % Assay as the final calculated column; an additional pct_mean = mean([pct_assay]) (no rounding) was added and drug_lipid routed through it. Justified by the user's %Mean clarification (evidence) and the sheet's ='Lipid '!O43 reference; behaviorally inert for the gold data. Confirm intended column set.
